006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import java.time.Duration;
009import java.time.ZoneOffset;
010
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.DateTimeFunctionException;
012import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
015
016/**
017 * An atomic Metapath item containing a temporal data value.
018 */
019public interface ITemporalItem extends IAnyAtomicItem {
020  /**
021   * Get the year value of this temporal.
022   *
023   * @return the year value
024   */
025  int getYear();
026
027  /**
028   * Get the month value of this temporal.
029   *
030   * @return the month value
031   */
032  int getMonth();
033
034  /**
035   * Get the day value of this temporal.
036   *
037   * @return the day value
038   */
039  int getDay();
040
041  /**
042   * Get the hour value of this temporal.
043   *
044   * @return the hour value
045   */
046  int getHour();
047
048  /**
049   * Get the minute value of this temporal.
050   *
051   * @return the minute value
052   */
053  int getMinute();
054
055  /**
056   * Get the whole second value of this temporal.
057   *
058   * @return the whole second value
059   */
060  int getSecond();
061
062  /**
063   * Get the partial nano second value of this temporal.
064   *
065   * @return the partial nano second value
066   */
067  int getNano();
068
069  /**
070   * Get the timezone offset for this temporal.
071   *
072   * @return the timezone offset if specified or {@code null} if the timezone is
073   *         not known
074   * @see ITemporalItem#hasTimezone()
075   */
076  @Nullable
077  ZoneOffset getZoneOffset();
078
079  /**
080   * Get the timezone offset as a day/time duration for this temporal.
081   *
082   * @return the timezone offset if specified or {@code null} if the timezone is
083   *         not known
084   * @see ITemporalItem#hasTimezone()
085   */
086  @Nullable
087  default IDayTimeDurationItem getOffset() {
088    ZoneOffset offset = getZoneOffset();
089    return offset == null
090        ? null
091        : IDayTimeDurationItem.valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(Duration.ofSeconds(offset.getTotalSeconds())));
092  }
093
094  /**
095   * Determine if the temporal item has a timezone.
096   *
097   * @return {@code true} if the temporal item has a timezone or {@code false}
098   *         otherwise
099   */
100  boolean hasTimezone();
101
102  /**
103   * Determine if the temporal has date information.
104   *
105   * @return {@code true} if the temporal item has date information or
106   *         {@code false} otherwise
107   */
108  boolean hasDate();
109
110  /**
111   * Determine if the temporal has time information.
112   *
113   * @return {@code true} if the temporal item has time information or
114   *         {@code false} otherwise
115   */
116  boolean hasTime();
117
118  /**
119   * Adjusts a temporal item value to a specific timezone, or to no timezone at
120   * all.
121   *
122   * @param offset
123   *          the timezone offset to use or {@code null}
124   * @return the adjusted temporal value
125   * @throws DateTimeFunctionException
126   *           with code
127   *           {@link DateTimeFunctionException#INVALID_TIME_ZONE_VALUE_ERROR} if
128   *           the offset is &lt; -PT14H or &gt; PT14H
129   */
130  @NonNull
131  ITemporalItem replaceTimezone(@Nullable IDayTimeDurationItem offset);
132}
